# Delivery.KW

> Delivery.KW (ديليفري الكويت / مندوب توصيل الكويت) is a door-to-door courier and delivery-driver service in Kuwait, available 24 hours a day. It covers all six governorates: Capital, Hawalli, Farwaniya, Mubarak Al-Kabeer, Ahmadi and Jahra.

## Services
- Personal item delivery (توصيل أغراض شخصية)
- Gift delivery (توصيل هدايا)
- Clothes and accessories delivery (توصيل ملابس وإكسسوارات)
- Restaurant order delivery (توصيل طلبات المطاعم)
- Instagram store and small-business order delivery, with special rates (توصيل طلبات المتاجر والمشاريع)

## How to order
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/96599454818 (+965 99454818)
- Send pickup area, drop-off area and item type; price and arrival time are confirmed on WhatsApp before pickup.
- Payment: cash or online.

## Links
- Website (Arabic): https://deliverykw.com/
